entries.headline: Gateholt demo launches on Steam
entries.summary: 4Gamer and Denfaminico report that DOMADOZ has released a Steam demo for Gateholt, supporting one to four players. Players remove traces from cursed locations to banish spirits, which become more aggressive as the cleansing progresses.

entries.headline: Shobota unveils a debt-driven fantasy adventure
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Shobota has opened the game's Steam page and released a demo. Its hero must fight the demon king while repaying the dragon companion's monthly installments. The PC release is planned for this year at an expected price of 490 yen.

entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Idea Factory's adventure label IFChronicle has announced ICONOLOGY for PC and Nintendo Switch. Players partner with detectives and investigate images extracted from suspects' minds as paintings. A teaser site and trailer have been released.

entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Project:Navi plans to release the game's Steam edition in 2027 with additional content. Players follow an on-screen navigation AI through a supposedly abandoned game, but the guide changes personality and may give unreliable instructions.

entries.headline: Crimson Desert expansion delayed to October 29
entries.summary: IGN relays Pearl Abyss's announcement that Charting the Unknown has been delayed by two weeks for polish and stability. The expansion is now due on October 29 for PS5, Xbox Series X and PC at $24.99, adding a new region and sea exploration.

entries.headline: IGN updates its Witcher 3 remaster impressions
entries.summary: In a new review update, IGN describes improvements to combat, camera lock-on and movement after roughly ten hours. The author still finds some enemy behavior dated; these are interim impressions rather than a final score.

entries.summary: AUTOMATON's new hands-on report describes a rapid loop of combat, upgrade selection and more combat with little waiting. Developed by Mixed Realms, 13Z is planned to support solo play and up to four-player co-op.

entries.headline: Marathon director reaffirms support for extraction
entries.summary: IGN relays game director Del Chafe's statement that extraction remains a major part of Marathon and will continue to receive updates. He also invited player feedback on what works and what needs improvement.

entries.headline: AUTOMATON interviews a researcher on gaming and social preferences
entries.summary: AUTOMATON publishes an email interview with Brian Confessor about earlier research, reader reactions, memories in games and digital communication. The papers appeared in July; the interview is the new material. The statistical associations do not establish that gaming causes social isolation.

entries.headline: Grave Seasons announces a March 2027 release
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays the publishers' announcement of a March 9, 2027 release for Grave Seasons, with March 10 shown in Japan due to the time difference. Developed by Perfect Garbage, the game combines farm life with a serial-killer investigation and is planned for Xbox and PC Game Pass.

entries.headline: Diablo V director discusses planning and character builds
entries.summary: IGN relays Joe Shely's statement that Diablo V will retain moment-to-moment execution mechanics while placing greater emphasis on planning and investment. He describes overcoming challenges with the right build as a design principle.
